scope: A matched fixed-seed control and scheduled-change pair on the accepted stock-based TEACH-DU-01 reorder at DEPOT-01. Both arms have nominal and opening on-hand stock four with initial ROSIZ two. The child alone schedules ROSIZ one at hour five, before the inherited hour-ten ordinary demand. No transfers or extra demand are introduced.

E02.accepted_scope: One zero-local-stock backorder and repair return, not stock reorder.

E15.accepted_scope: Tracked DU depot STSIZ four, ROSIZ two, default opening on-hand four; the h10 demand lowers on-hand to three without a reorder. This is the direct source parent, not acceptance of the catalog above-nominal E15.var07 boundary.

I02_IN.accepted_scope: One zero-delay IN transfer and station-specific nominal/on-hand stock ledger.

I02_BETWEEN.accepted_scope: One zero-delay BETWEEN transfer after IN, with depot/base physical and nominal stock ledgers. No transfer is reused by this experiment.

source.manual_boundary: ChangesStockAllocation may change only ROSIZ for an existing POINT/IID/STID stock row. The change itself does not place an order; the next demand or scheduled transfer reapplies the strategy. The first subsequent order may exceed the new ROSIZ. Stock state includes on-hand, outstanding reorders and transfers; nominal STSIZ and actual on-hand are distinct.

environment.execution: Unique immutable run directory; session-0 loopback SSH with sshd ancestor; nonblocking Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue mutex; no concurrent native job; GUI identity checked before and after each hidden CLI child.

configuration.initial_on_hand_source: ISTOH omitted; native default opens at STSIZ four

frozen_source.parent_delta: Both arms change the accepted E15 default-arm description to the same text and add an otherwise identical six-column ChangesStockAllocation table immediately after StockAllocation. The control has one all-null placeholder; the child has POINT AIR_BASIC, IID TEACH-DU-01, STID DEPOT-01, TIMEC five, ROSIZ one, NOTE null. All 31 inherited tables, including initial StockAllocation and ItemReorder, are unchanged except shared description.
frozen_source.paired_delta: The only value difference between the two frozen inputs is the ChangesStockAllocation row: all-null control versus one scheduled ROSIZ=1 row.

report_selector.purpose: Select TEACH-DU-01 at DEPOT-01 ItemResults and mission tables in each arm.

predeclared_gates: Before native execution, an independent reviewer confirms source, parent, manual, dictionary and pair-diff pins; the runner is frozen and a unique run ID is unoccupied.

Both arms import and export with exact row-containing-table roundtrip, zero converter errors, only reviewed warnings, valid nonempty SXO, event log and selected report. The protected GUI survives every native child.
At hour five the scheduled ROSIZ change alone causes no reorder, physical stock movement or nominal stock movement. Control and child remain matched until the inherited hour-ten ordinary demand.

At hour ten the shared demand lowers depot on-hand from four to three. The accepted ROSIZ-two control predicts no reorder because its reorder point is two. The ROSIZ-one child predicts one order triggered at the new reorder point three, and with LEADT one predicts its arrival at hour eleven. Treat the exact native batch size as a falsifiable outcome, not an assumption that it equals the new ROSIZ.

Enumerate every reorder start, size, completion, arrival and physical item identity in both arms. Reconcile any batch size, including one larger than new ROSIZ, with the native event and stock-state ledger.

Across all 72 half-hour selected depot ItemResults bins per arm, reconcile STSZ, STOHA, NRO, ordinary demand/backorder and terminal stock with the full raw event ledger, including shipments to the base and outstanding orders. Reconcile mission, system and aggregate stock results to accepted E15 scope.

If both arms are observationally identical or any expected contrast, import, report, ledger, identity or event gate fails, retain this immutable run as failed or diagnostic evidence and do not claim positive ROSIZ behavior.
limits: One fixed seed, one DU stock-based reorder point, one ordinary demand, h5 ROSIZ 2-to-1 change and a 36-hour horizon; no time-based reorder, multiple outstanding orders, random lead, transfer at change time, other stations or seeds.
The control and change remain matched in initial stock and business events; CLI-only evidence does not verify GUI display or cross-engine semantics.
A publication based on this experiment cannot close full I07.var02 or Issue #18 without evidence of the broader catalog boundary.
